sloka: इमां हत्वा ततो रामं लक्ष्मणं त्वां च वानर।सुग्रीवं च वधिष्यामि तं चानार्यं विभीषणम् ।। ६.८१.२९ ।।
transliteration: imāṁ hatvā tato rāmaṁ lakṣmaṇaṁ tvāṁ ca vānara।sugrīvaṁ ca vadhiṣyāmi taṁ cānāryaṁ vibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.81.29 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith having spoken like that killed that crying illusory Sita with a sharpedged sword.
